# Mirror lockstep drift register (ADR-0152 dual-support)
#
# One row per line: <v4-module> <side> <symbol> <reason...>
#   side=v4: symbol exists only on the v4 side — transition lag, or a
#            never-mirror verdict for surface that dies at the v5 cut.
#   side=v5: symbol exists only on the core/v5 side — deliberate v5
#            evolution (the audit trail for divergence decisions).
# A trailing "/..." on <symbol> covers a whole subpackage subtree.
#
# Enforced by TestMirrorLockstep in cmd/api-stability/mirror_lockstep_test.go:
# any drift NOT classified here fails CI, and rows that no longer cover any
# drift fail as stale — prune them when the sides reconverge. The per-pair
# lag/evolved counts in the test log are the v4→v5 migration ratchet.

event/v4 v4 eventtest/... pending-mirror: eventtest suite not yet forked into core/v5/event (ADR-0152 transition lag; closure = eventtest + snapshot + storage/memory, test-coupled — see TODO_LIST M23)
kv/v4 v4 func NewCacheForViewStore pending-mirror: view-store cache landed in v4 kv (issue #113, 2026-11-04 sweep); core/v5/kv Cache still holds *TypedStore — folding requires the ViewStore+copyFn restructure, part of the kv mirror wave, not a mechanical copy
kv/v4 v4 func WithCacheCopyFunc pending-mirror: same restructure as NewCacheForViewStore — the v5 cacheConfig has no copyFn field yet
command/v4 v4 commandtest/... pending-mirror: commandtest suite helpers relabeled under the module dir (v4-layout rename wave, 2026-11-09); no v5 fork yet
id/v4 v4 idtest/... pending-mirror: idtest suite helpers relabeled under the module dir (v4-layout rename wave, 2026-11-09)
query/v4 v4 querytest/... pending-mirror: querytest suite helpers relabeled under the module dir (v4-layout rename wave, 2026-11-09)
event/v4 v5 func WithCause deliberate v5 evolution (M07, R6): first-class causation typed at birth; the v4 train keeps only the metadata Causation twin until T26
event/v4 v5 method Cause deliberate v5 evolution (M07, R6): ImmutableEvent carries record.Cause; v4 reconstructs from metadata precedence instead
id/v4 v5 func NewStreamRefOrZero deliberate v5 evolution (M04, ADR-0166): error-free producer counterpart to the validating id.NewStreamRef; v4 has no validating constructor
id/v4 v5 func ParseStreamRef deliberate v5 evolution (M04, ADR-0166): StreamKey inverse; the v4 slash-form string ref has no storage-key parser
record/v4 v4 func NewStreamRef never-mirror (M04, ADR-0166): the slash-joined string constructor died in core/v5 — record.StreamRef is the id.StreamRef struct alias; v4 copy stays frozen until T26
record/v4 v4 func NewStreamRefOrZero never-mirror (M04, ADR-0166): string-form twin of the constructor above; the v5 OrZero lives in id and takes typed parts
record/v4 v4 method Split never-mirror (M04, ADR-0166): splitting died with the string form; the struct ref exposes Type and ID directly
record/v4 v4 method Validate never-mirror (M04, ADR-0166): the struct ref validates via id.StreamRef.Validate; the string-form method is not re-mirrored
record/v4 v4 var ErrInvalidStreamRef never-mirror (M04, ADR-0166): sentinel of the dead string form; v5 rejects via id.ErrEmptyStreamType / id.nil_stream_id rejections
record/v4 v5 const EncodingEnvelope deliberate v5 evolution (M05, R4): the ADR-0044 wrapping fact as a stamp; not a codec name, ParseEncoding rejects it
record/v4 v5 struct Payload deliberate v5 evolution (M05, R4): bytes + codec stamp fused so presence is honest states (absent/opaque/wrapped/stamped)
record/v4 v5 func PayloadFrom deliberate v5 evolution (M05, R4): the Payload constructor (empty data normalizes to absent)
record/v4 v5 method IsZero deliberate v5 evolution (M05, R4): Payload presence check — data-only fact
record/v4 v5 method UInt64 deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): record.Version exposes the raw uint64 (0 = unversioned); v4 carries int64 in Record
record/v4 v5 type Version deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): uint64 brand, 0 = unversioned; the v4 Record field is int64
record/v4 v5 type InstanceID deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): branded record instance identity (EventID/CommandID/RequestID meeting point)
record/v4 v5 type CorrelationID deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): string brand carrying foreign correlation IDs (ULID-ness is id/'s minting concern)
record/v4 v5 func ParseInstanceID deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): validating constructor for the brand
record/v4 v5 func ParseVersion deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): validating constructor (rejects negative legacy forms)
record/v4 v5 func ParseCorrelationID deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): validating constructor (rejects empty)
record/v4 v5 var ErrEmptyInstanceID deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): brand sentinel
record/v4 v5 var ErrNegativeVersion deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): brand sentinel
record/v4 v5 var ErrEmptyCorrelationID deliberate v5 evolution (M03, R2): brand sentinel
